# Chinese ASR self-test

`asr-benchmark-zh.wav` is a locally synthesized, mono 16 kHz PCM16 fixture generated for this project with macOS Tingting. Spoken text: “桌上有个蓝色的杯子。” It contains no live-room recording or personal data. It is used only for warmup, transcript correctness and latency measurement; its transcript must never enter live evidence. Preserve with the extension's worker assets.
